2. Discriminating negative fixtures
-----------------------------------
Each fixture breaks the bundle in one exact way. The named check MUST fail.
A fixture whose text anchor no longer matches is INAPP: it is reported as
lost coverage, not as a defect the suite detected. The two are never merged,
because anchor drift that reads as detection is a false red (S1R3-N07).
